name: Pledge
description: Stake USDC on personal goals. 100% completion returns full stake; partial completion returns a proportional amount minus fee; failure forfeits tokens to treasury/charity.
policy: Please report vulnerabilities privately by DM to @Pledge_dapp on X, or by joining our Telegram community (https://t.me/+79qOqyJ_WYExYTk5) and messaging an admin directly — do not post details in the group. Include a clear description, reproduction steps, and an assessment of impact. Do not disclose publicly until the issue is patched and deployed. A good-faith acknowledgement will be provided; there is no formal bounty program at this time.
